paneSubagentsBackground: background, still running after the turn
paneCloseAgentRunning: An agent is running in this pane. Closing it ends its session.
paneCloseAgentOpened: An agent was opened in this pane. Closing it ends the panel.
paneCloseSessionBody: This session has an agent in it. Closing the session ends it.
paneCloseProjectBody: This project has an agent in it. Closing the project ends it.
paneCloseProjectBodyIdle: Closing the project closes every session and pane in it.
paneDetached: Moved to the background; restore it in Settings › Worktrees.
sessionIdleFlash: Session set to idle; find it at the bottom of the sidebar.
sessionArchivedFlash: Session archived; find it in Settings › Archive.
sessionCloseBody: The session stops running, including any agent inside it. Archive keeps it in Settings; Idle keeps it at the bottom of the sidebar. You can open it again from either place.
settingsShowSidebarDetail: Hide the session list to give the window to panes.
settingsLiquidGlassDetail: Let the sidebar show the desktop through the system's material. Off, the sidebar matches the canvas and wraps the panes in one surface.
settingsRestoreScreenDetail: Paint the previous screen above the new shell.
worktreeCreateHint: Create a worktree for this pane
worktreeNotRepo: This project is not a git repository.
worktreeNotRoot: Open the repository root as the project to create a worktree.
worktreeNoBase: Could not find the origin default branch, main, or master to branch from.
worktreeCreateNamePlaceholder: Leave empty for a random name
worktreeCreateShared: This project has {count} other panes sharing the folder; moving changes takes theirs too.
worktreeSplitProject: The new pane opens in the project folder; this worktree belongs to the original pane.
worktreeArchiveBody: This closes every pane in the worktree and deletes its folder.
worktreeArchiveKeep: The branch is kept, so you can restore it from Worktrees.
worktreeArchiveDirty: Uncommitted changes will be deleted too.
worktreeArchiveDirtySkipped: The merged worktree has uncommitted changes, so it was not archived automatically.
worktreeArchiveIgnored: Ignored files (such as .env) will be deleted too.
worktreeArchiveIgnoredSkipped: The merged worktree has ignored files, so it was not archived automatically.
worktreeLeftAgentStopped: Worktree removed; back in the project folder. The agent was stopped; start a new conversation here.
worktreeAgentRunning: Stop the agent in this pane first.
worktreeAgentStuck: Could not stop the agent in this pane.
worktreePRBodyAgentFailed: Could not ask {agent} for a description: {error}
worktreeArchiveHint: Archive this worktree; restore it from Settings
worktreeArchived: Archived {branch}; restore it in Settings › Worktrees
worktreeMergedLocalFailed: Merged on GitHub, but local {base} could not be updated: {error}
worktreeResolveConflicts: Ask {agent} to resolve the conflicts, then merge
worktreeResolvePending: Conflicts resolved and pushed; GitHub has not caught up yet. Press Merge again.
worktreeStashKept: The changes could not be put back; they are in git stash. Copy the command to restore them.
commitMessageNoAgent: No agent is running in this pane; type the message here.
commitMessageAgentFailed: Could not ask {agent} for a message: {error}
worktreeBlockedMerged: the pull request is already merged
worktreeBlockedBehind: the branch is behind the base
worktreeBlockedGeneric: GitHub will not merge this pull request now
worktreeLeaveHint: Leave this worktree and return to the project
worktreeLeaveUnmerged: There are {count} commits that are not merged. The branch {branch} will be kept.
worktreeLeaveDirty: There are uncommitted changes. They will be lost.
worktreeLeft: Worktree removed; back in the project folder.
worktreeKeptClose: Worktree kept at {path}; find it in Settings › Worktrees.
worktreeGoneHint: This pane's worktree folder is gone. Click to clear it and open Settings › Worktrees.
worktreeGoneNotice: The worktree folder {path} is gone; the pane was cleared. See Settings › Worktrees.
worktreeGoneFailed: The worktree folder is gone. See Settings › Worktrees.
settingsArchiveAfterMergeDetail: Clear the merged worktree and its pane away when the pull request merges, instead of leaving the Archive button for you.
settingsWorktreesEmpty: No worktrees yet. Create one with a pane's W button.
archiveSessionDeleteBody: “{title}” will be deleted for good, with the commands that reopen its panes. This cannot be undone.
worktreeDeleteBrokenBody: The folder {path} is no longer a git worktree. Deleting it removes the files left in it; this cannot be undone.
settingsCleanupWorktreesDetail: Remove checkouts no pane uses that have no changes and no commits ahead.
worktreeClearArchivedDetail: Delete the {count} archived branches and their remote counterparts.
worktreeClearArchivedBody: This deletes {count} archived branches and their remote counterparts. This cannot be undone.
worktreeClearKeptDetail: Delete the {count} branches kept by Leave, including their unmerged commits.
worktreeClearKeptBody: This deletes {count} branches kept by Leave, including commits that were never merged. This cannot be undone.
archiveDeleteBody: Branch {branch} and its checkout will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settingsDesktopNotificationsDetail: Sent when an agent finishes a turn or waits for input.
settingsNotifyTestDetail: Checks that a banner reaches this Mac.
testNotificationBody: If this banner shows up, agent events can reach you.
newProjectMessage: Choose the folder this project works in.
drawerNotRepo: This folder is not a Git repository.
drawerTooLarge: This file is too large to show.
drawerNoBase: No base branch to compare against.
settingsRemoteAllow: Allow this Mac to be reached
settingsRemoteAllowDetail: Other Macs and phones on the same network can view your sessions and type in them.
settingsRemoteCodeDetail: Enter it on the other Mac or phone.
remoteAddBody: On the other Mac, open Settings › Remote and enter its address and pairing code here.
remoteNotPaired: This Mac is no longer paired; add it again.
renamePaneHint: The name you set stays; or make one from the first message as date|kind|subject.
renameSessionHint: The name you set stays; the agent will not change it.
settingsRelayEnableDetail: Keep a link to a server you run, so this Mac is reachable from anywhere without a public address or a router rule.
settingsRelayIncomplete: Fill in the relay address, tunnel, token and fingerprint first.
relayDialogBody: Run gexi-relay on a server you own, then paste what `gexi-relay init` prints.
relayFingerprintMissing: The fingerprint must be 64 hex characters; copy the one gexi-relay printed.
permissionsIntro: These belong to gexi. Terminals and agents running inside it inherit them, so granting once is enough.
permissionsScreenRecordingDetail: Window captures, interface checks, and anything that needs to see the screen.
permissionsFullDiskAccessDetail: Mail, Safari, other apps' data, and the system's protected folders.
permissionsAccessibilityDetail: Read other apps' windows and controls, and operate their interface.
permissionsRestartHint: Screen Recording takes effect after gexi starts again.
remoteCodeOnlyHint: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the other Mac or phone.
